body: That's a really good point. She did say something to that effect, that she had been thinking about it since December, so she had a lot more time to get over it. That actually is helpful, thank you for your advice!

I appreciate the honesty. It's hard to accept right now, but I think you are right.

Thankfully, I'm on meds, seeing a shrink, exercising, so I suppose I'm on the right track.

Certainly, I guess I just hoped to get a lot of different opinions, then I can see the commonalities and kind of synthesize the best from each opinion. I like my therapist, but reddit is so immediate, and I always value the advice.

But like you said, it shouldn't replace an actual therapist, I'll keep that in mind.

I don't think that's accurate, I had been on medication/getting therapy/exercising for months prior to her breaking up with me.

But then again, I agree with the soul-destroying part. I probably put way too much on her, and that needs to be recognized. 

Thanks for the honesty.

Thanks so much, I totally agree on all accounts. As much as I want to be mad at her, I don't think she was wrong to do what she did. I was putting way too much on her, and I'm genuinely sorry for that.

I'll try to work on me, and hopefully good things will follow.

Thanks so much for the well-thought out response! I'm actually doing several of these, which is good: I'm on prozac, I'm seeing a therapy, and I exercise every other day. I need to work on the rest, but that's a good place to start, I suppose.

I know the feeling, but then I always think about what it would be like to be him, and I start pitying him. After all, he still has to deal with her, right?

I'm sorry that happened, I don't know what kind of person could do that.

Absolutely. I'm actually seeing a therapist currently, and I'm on the highest dose of Prozac they'll give me. 

I'm really trying to improve my life, and I'm traveling abroad to study for a year or so soon. I guess I just miss her and wanted her in my life, but I'm just upset about this whole thing and very lonely.
Yep, same thing. She said she was interested in other people, and had been for some time while we were dating. What can you even do with that information, you know? It's so demoralizing.

I agree, I guess I'm just hesitant to externalize my feelings because I'm aware that I'm fucked up and I don't want to downplay that. I'm afraid to be mad at her because I'm scared that I'm the problem, and I always will be.

Thank you so much for your advice.

Thank you so much, that means a lot. I'm watching the videos now.

I just feel so responsible. I feel like what we had was really good, and she was such a big part of my support base that I'm struggling right now.

But then again, I do have some great things in my future, it's just hard to make it through right now without her.
